source_schema_policy: Raw historical result.json files are read-only. Legacy pipeline_sustainable_rate fields are ignored; stages are recomputed from canonical Bronze/Silver steady-state metrics with supported legacy aliases.
aggregation_rule: Aggregate each stage across valid repetitions, then pipeline_sustainable_rate is min(aggregated Bronze steady-state rate, aggregated Silver steady-state rate). If either stage rate is absent, non-finite, non-positive, or any included valid repetition lacks either stage rate, pipeline is null.
speedup_rule: candidate pipeline sustainable rate / same-workload baseline pipeline sustainable rate. Compute efficiency uses actual allocated cores.

interpretation_threshold.statistical_note: Two-run comparisons are descriptive and do not establish statistical significance.

diagnostic_only.pipeline_rate_reason: No correctness-complete valid repetition; partial stage rates are retained only in the raw result artifact and are excluded from comparison.

observations.reason: Host free physical memory fell to 331 MiB during the first P3-B2-S2-W1 attempt. The benchmark process was interrupted; its two run-scoped Spark apps were then stopped by exact app ID. No unrelated containers were stopped.

observed: broker process/container stopped with exit code 137 while Spark could reach only 214799 records
Spark logged broker unavailable; Kafka lag and Docker stats sampling timed out
broker logs after restart recovered 159 logs because no clean shutdown marker was present
c2_diagnosis.historical_oom_killed: unknown; Docker had no retained event or historical inspect state for the failed container instance. The later restarted container showed OOMKilled=false, ExitCode=0, RestartCount=0, which does not establish the cause of the prior exit.

current_host_capacity.interpretation: resource pressure is plausible but not proven; no resource setting was changed and no retry was run

c2_diagnosis.retry: not run; original cause cannot be safely resolved without changing the experimental environment or benchmark allocation.
